name: krndocs
description: Plataforma privada de documentação da equipe de Cybersegurança - Kernel Solutions

scripts.dev: node scripts/run24.mjs 'npm run build:shared && node scripts/dev.mjs'
scripts.build: node scripts/run24.mjs 'npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @krndocs/api && npm run build --workspace @krndocs/web'
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/run24.mjs 'npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present'
scripts.test: node scripts/run24.mjs 'npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present'
